profile.summary: Gameheads is an Oakland, California program that uses video game design and development to train young people ages 15 to 25 for careers in technology and gaming. It offers classes, mentorship, and career preparation for students, with a focus on low-income youth and youth of color. It operates as a fiscally sponsored project of the nonprofit Community Initiatives.
